identity.evidence: Bald faceless white-grey canonical anatomy-v3 athlete, neutral featureless pelvis and white trainers retained in all three native poses.

contact.evidence: Native inspection confirms both palms/fingers contact the bench edge and heels remain planted. Overlapping shoe silhouettes prevent independent threshold-based heel measurement; no such measurement claimed.

physics.evidence: Hips remain forward of bench edge, supported through palms and heels. Body lowers as elbows bend backward and rises as elbows extend. Extended legs pivot toward fixed heels. No detached hands or moving bench.

muscles.evidence: Primary triceps strong purple; chest and front deltoids light lilac. Other anatomy neutral.

cueAgreement.evidence: Six cues match exact bench-dips catalogue variation and contain at most seven words. Bottom cue describes approximate ninety-degree bend; no precise angle measurement claimed.

sequenceAndLoop.evidence: All six beats and 6-to-1 loop stepped in real player in both themes. Frame 4 repeats 3, 5 repeats 2, 6 repeats 1. Intermediate pose is closer to bottom than halfway; it still shows a distinct partial bend.
